title: Core: timeline frame operations (insert/remove frames)
description: Check packages/core/src/model/timeline.ts or engine/timeline.ts for insertFrame, removeFrame, insertKeyframe, insertBlankKeyframe operations. If they exist, add comprehensive unit tests. If missing, implement: insertFrame(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx, atFrame) - inserts a regular frame; removeFrame - removes a frame; these shift frame indices. All immutable. Tests in packages/core/src/model/__tests__/timeline.test.ts or engine/__tests__/frames.test.ts.
